title: Getting started with Packio
assistedIntro: The Packio Partner team has entered some of this for you. Please check it and sign it off.
selfIntro: Fill in each step; the Packio Partner team reviews it and gets back to you.
inactive: The factory is not taking jobs. Contact the Partner team with any questions.

under_review.title: In review
under_review.body: The Partner team reviews and visits

signOffCallout.title: {count, plural, one {# step waits} other {# steps wait}} for your sign-off
signOffCallout.body: Packio entered these for you. Open each one and sign it off when it is right.

application.title: Application and company
application.body: Company name, tax id, addresses and contacts

kyc.title: Company documents (KYC)
kyc.body: Company certificate, ภ.พ.20, director ID and other documents

bank_account.title: Payout bank account
bank_account.body: The account Packio pays you into — changed only with two approvals

capability.title: Production capability
capability.body: Product types, maximum sheet sizes and order quantities you take

capacity.title: Weekly capacity
capacity.body: Capacity per product type, used to promise delivery dates

delivery_zones.title: Delivery zones
delivery_zones.body: Where your own fleet delivers, and what Packio pays for it

pricing_arrangement.title: Pricing arrangement
pricing_arrangement.body: Who owns the price table, and your tier for each product type

tolerance.title: Quantity tolerance
tolerance.body: How far short or over a delivery may be without a claim

agreement.title: Partner agreement
agreement.body: Read and accept the agreements in force

site_visit.title: Site visit
site_visit.body: Packio visits the factory at least once before activation

trial.title: Trial production
trial.body: Your first jobs, each one inspected by Packio

recordedByPackio: The Packio Partner team records this. If it is wrong or has changed, send a request below.

signOff.ownerOnly: The factory owner signs this off.
signOff.title: Sign off “{step}”
signOff.body: You confirm that the “{step}” data Packio entered for your factory is correct. The sign-off is recorded in your name.
signOff.calloutTitle: This step waits for your sign-off
signOff.calloutBody: Packio entered the data below for your factory. Check all of it and sign off when it is right; if it is not, send a change request instead.
signOff.signedAt: Your factory signed this off on {date}

company.title: Company
company.locked: Locked. To change it, send the Partner team a request.
company.tradeNameHint: The name Packio staff know you by
company.taxIdInvalid: This tax id is not valid; check the digits
company.vatRegisteredHint: This decides the tax invoices you issue to Packio
company.stale: Someone changed this first; the latest is loaded — check it again
company.legalNamePlaceholder: As registered, e.g. Packdee Co., Ltd.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Full name
contacts.phoneInvalid: A phone number starts with 0 and has 9–10 digits
contacts.emailInvalid: This email address is not valid

submit.sectionBody: Once the company, addresses, contacts and documents are in, send the application to the Partner team.
submit.title: Send the application to Packio
submit.body: Send {name}'s application to the Partner team. You can still edit the company details until the review ends.
submit.reason: Submitted by the factory in the partner zone
submit.done: Application sent — the Partner team will be in touch

kyc.title: Documents sent
kyc.body: Packio checks every document; an expired one must be sent again.
kyc.emptyBody: Start with a company certificate issued in the last 6 months
kyc.fileHint: A PDF or a clear photo
kyc.rules: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 20 MB
kyc.wrongType: {name} is not a PDF, JPG or PNG
kyc.added: Document sent — waiting for Packio to check it

bank.title: Payout accounts
bank.body: For your security only the last 4 digits are shown.
bank.changeTitle: Add or change the payout account
bank.changeBody: A new account is confirmed by phone and approved twice by Packio Finance; until then Packio pays the current one.
bank.pendingTitle: A new account is awaiting approval
bank.pendingBody: Packio Finance will call your primary contact before approving it.
bank.accountNameHint: Must match the factory's legal name
bank.confirmBody: Ask Packio to pay into the bank {bank} account ending {last4} once approved. Type the last 4 digits to confirm.
bank.proposed: Change requested — waiting for Finance to approve it

capability.title: What you make
capability.askBody: A new product type, a new machine, a larger size…
capability.askPlaceholder: Tell us what changed, e.g. a new 5-colour 28×40" press

capacity.weeksCaption: Booked and free capacity in the coming weeks
capacity.askBody: Capacity sets the dates promised to customers; the Partner team adjusts it after checking.
capacity.askPlaceholder: E.g. a press is down next week, or a night shift starts

zones.title: Where your fleet delivers
zones.body: Some zones take longer; Packio adds that to the date it gives the customer.
zones.shippingRates: See what Packio pays for delivery
zones.askPlaceholder: E.g. we now deliver to the East

platform_rate_card.title: Packio's rate card
platform_rate_card.body: Packio sets the buy-price table; you accept it whole or line by line and can ask for other rates on some lines.

factory_price_list.title: Your own price list
factory_price_list.body: You keep your own price table and propose changes; Packio reviews and approves them before they apply.

pricing.tiersTitle: Your tier for each product type
pricing.tiersBody: The tier decides whether customers get an instant price or ask for a quote.

tiers.A: Full price list — instant quotes and automatic job allocation
tiers.B: Prices for some specs, such as standard sizes — instant quotes there, quote requests outside
tiers.C: Quote on request — no price table; Packio asks you for a price job by job

pricing.askBody: Tier A gives customers instant prices and brings you more jobs.
pricing.askPlaceholder: E.g. we are ready to price every size

tolerance.title: Delivery quantity tolerance
tolerance.body: Customers see this tolerance when they are quoted; each job keeps it.
tolerance.band: Short by up to {shortage} · over by up to {overage}
tolerance.rule: Short within tolerance: paid for what was delivered. Over within tolerance: not paid extra. Outside it: a claim opens automatically.
tolerance.askBody: A factory-specific tolerance needs Packio's approval.
tolerance.askPlaceholder: E.g. rigid boxes lose more in forming — we ask for 8% short

payout.title: How Packio pays you
payout.body: As agreed in your contract. Contact the Partner team to change it.

triggers.after_pod_and_claim_window: delivery is proved and the claim window has passed

payout.retentionValue: {pct}, released {days} days after the claim window

agreement.acceptedSigned: Accepted with a signed copy on {date}
agreement.ownerOnly: The factory owner accepts the agreement.
agreement.confirmBody: Accepting {name}, version {version}, binds the factory. Packio keeps your name, the time and the text as evidence.

visit.title: Visit results
visit.body: At least one visit must pass before activation.
visit.askBody: Pick days the factory can host Packio; the team confirms one.
visit.askPlaceholder: E.g. ask for Somchai at gate 2 from 9 am

trial.title: Trial jobs
trial.body: During the trial Packio inspects every job; once they pass, the Partner team activates you.
trial.completed: {count, plural, one {# trial job} other {# trial jobs}} completed

activation.title: Activation
activation.body: The Partner team activates you after the site visit and the trial.
